items.quote: They notice what other cleaners miss — fixtures, edges, the little things that make a home feel finished.
Professional, consistent, and easy to work with. Exactly what we wanted for recurring service.

about.heading: Led by Kelsey O'Brien
body: Maid & Marble was built for homeowners who want more than a quick wipe-down — meticulous care, reliable scheduling, and a team that treats your home with respect.
Kelsey works directly with every client: walk-through, clear scope, and follow-through. Licensed and insured across Central Massachusetts.
